  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]

  WHY: Prompt rendering is now on the hot path for every workflow, so the extra disk round-trip is a regression from the previous direct Python execution path.
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:13-16 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The mktemp-backed rendered output relies on an EXIT trap for cleanup, so SIGKILL can leave stale temporary files behind.
  WHY: EXIT traps do not run on SIGKILL, which can leak /tmp files on abnormal termination.
- prompts/contracts/mode-validate-generate.yml:3 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]

  WHY: The Python parser tolerates it, but the contract schema is inconsistent and may confuse tooling or maintainers.

  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
